is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses exclusively on Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus (e.g. title: 'Susceptibility profile and metabolic mechanisms involved in Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus resistant to DDT and deltamethrin in the Central African Republic').

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study tested Aedes voltage-gated sodium channel mutations (I1011M/V, V1016G/I, F1534C), not any of the specified target markers for Anopheles.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype data for Anopheles target resistance markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Field populations were collected in Bangui, Central African Republic, between June and September 2014, but they are Aedes mosquitoes, not Anopheles.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study describing field collections, bioassays, biochemical assays, and kdr sequencing.

sub_country_location.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from six specific districts in Bangui (IPB, Sica 1, Lakouanga, Ouango, Ngongonon 3, 92 Logements).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Immature stages were collected between June and September 2014.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine original field survey in Bangui, CAR.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary information is needed; the paper is non-Anopheles.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated larval and adult insecticide susceptibility and resistance mechanisms (biochemical assays and kdr screening) in field-caught Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus from Bangui, Central African Republic. It does not study Anopheles or target Anopheles resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: The study investigates Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, not Anopheles vectors.
Target insecticide-resistance markers in Anopheles were not genotyped.
